tenderSchedule.description: Construction of Sewerage System in Madikeri City Phase-2 under NGT & SBM(U) 2.0 fund in DBOT model
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Urban Infrastructure Development and Finance Corporation Limited

generalCriterionList.description: Single entity or Joint venture(maximum 2 members) is acceptable
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should quote exclusive of GST
Tenderer are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
Should comply all the conditions as per the tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Executed in any one year of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) the following minimum quantities of works Earthwork excavation in all kinds of soil by mechanical / manual means 15122 cum (2) Cement Concrete (Including RCC & PCC) 1412 cum (3) TMT Steel 22.82 MT (4) RCC NP3/ DI/ u-PVC/ Stone ware/ MS pipes/DWC/GSW/HDPE of minimum 63mm dia and above 11.16 km
The tenderer or his identified subcontractor should possess experience in Construction of 1 No. of SBR/ NEBR/equivalent/any other type STP/ WTP/ETP works with a minimum of 0.15 MLD Capacity

Availability by owning at least 50% of the required/specified key and critical equipment for this work and (b) the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease /hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.) for availability for this work are furnished.

Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 5.08 Crore (credit lines/letter of credit/Certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in the peak construction period) in the form of unconditional credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificate from any Nationalized Banks/ Scheduled Banks from Karnataka -India as per the prescribed format.
Achieved in each of the at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 33.87 Crores

itemList.description: Part A - 1. Construction of sewer network, machineholes, HSC, including restoration of roads & other allied works at in Madikeri Town. a) Site cleaning, excavation in all kinds of strata, including cutting and excavation & Restoration of Asphalt Road,Concrete Road, Pavers etc. b) Providing and laying pipeline of varying diameter u-PVC SN-8 pipes conforming to IS 16098:2013, including specials and all other appurtenances in ULB premises - 9.34 Km. c) Providing and laying pipeline of varying diameter DI pipes for culvert Crossing confirming to IS 8329:2000- 420 m. d) Providing and laying pipeline of varying diameter PVC ringtite pipes conforming to IS IS 4985:2000, including specials and all other appurtenances for Repair & Replacement of Water Supply Pipe Line Works - 1.645 Km. e) Providing and construction of cast-in-situ / pre-cast RCC machineholes of varying diameter with heavy duty SFRC covers. f) Providing and laying 110 mm dia PVC-U pipe dia SN 8 grade and Providing and fixing 315 mm dia PE inspection chamber with lid and inlet and outlet arrangments with Necessary Civil works including excavation, concrete works and pipe fittings, restoration works etc. complete - 553 No. etc. g) Providing and Laying pipeline of varying diameter HDPE Grade PE100-PN10.0 Class Rising Main confirming to IS 4984-2016 .h) Supply, errection, electrification and commissioning  of  14 Nos required HP non clog sewage pumpsets in pumping machinehole  i) Construction of Pillar supports/pedestals and Collection Chambers for Sewer Network in Nala crossings. j) Refilling available earth around trenches, pipelines or machineholes. k) Restoration of roads to original condition l) Any other appurtenance/Allied works applicable as per the site conditions and design requirement. m) Other allied works to complete the work, etc. Note: 1) All works and items shall be executed as per the IS, MoRTH specifications, CPHEEO guidelines, KSPCB, prevailing NGTguidelines and specifications mentioned in the contract. 2) Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the engineer in charge. 3) Drawings are enclosed only for tender purpose.

PART- B: 1) Construction of 5 no's AABR  (Advanced Attached Growth Bio reactor) or equivalent Technology STP of various sizes (250KLD at Pocket-1A & 1B, 100KLD at Pocket 4, 100KLD at Pocket 5, 200KLD at Zone 4, 100KLD at Zone 5) at Madikeri Town. a) Construction of AABR type STP complete including all civil works of the treatment units, installation of Stainless steel Advanced Attached Bio- Reactor Process Vessels, post filtration units, necessary fixing of platforms along with railings, pumping machineries and all electromechanical components to meet required standards. b) Providing and installation of 11 Nos of 11 KV express feeder line including transformers to the proposed STP and collections chambers including internal electrical works and allied accessories. c) Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning of 5 Nos of OCEMS, and Flowmeters for STP. d) Construction of 4 Nos of  Barbed Wire Fencing at proposed STPs. e) Construction of 4 Nos of Guard Room and Toilet room at proposed STPs. Note: 1) Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the engineer in charge. 2) All works and items shall be executed to be carried out as per IS code, CPHEEO manual, KSPCB, Prevailing NGT and Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban 2.0 guidelines and specifications mentioned in the contract. 3) Drawings are enclosed only for tender purpose.

Part C - O & M for 1st Year Madikeri Town - Operation and maintenance of the proposed STP which includes, providing technical staff, operators, and others who are required to run the system in a complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required, for the operation of STP works 1. Regular maintenance of all civil structures inside the STP premises. The maintenance consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, and painting for civil structures  2. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery, and other mechanical components including electrical maintenance covering all repairs/replacement of transformers / electrical cable/switchboards/replacement of burnt parts of machinery all the above repairs & maintenance will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge for the satisfactory functioning of the STP. Note: Helpers / Watchman / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at STP. The contractor should maintain a Logbook on the working of pumping machinery at the STP.
